source.scope: Original continuous ordinary main-loop branch 0x4a63d2..0x4a7b27 (or no-wheel/rear-only branch exits): complete contacts, component/cooldown, initial shared forces, roll target, subsequent mount world-position reads, wheel levers, front contact axis and chassis terrain probes, crash component steering and airborne/landing flags, takeoff state capture and rider weight filtering and grounded/airborne force reference position, local/crash reference transform and front suspension response, steering velocity and front load preparation and front tangent/contact velocity and front tire force with preserved skipped scratch/control state. Finite synthetic state and terrain, four-node parent/child graphs with all mount pairings and aliasing, speed/angle boundaries and signed-zero cases. Pinned Wine 11 D3DRM. Initial query scratch and exit observation boundaries supplied. Later force assembly and whole-bike trajectories excluded.
